title: Really wanted this to work
text: Really wanted this to work. I cook a lot but I have a very small kitchen and my pots and pans don't exactly fit comfortably in any of my cabinets, so I decided to get this organizer to help make everything look less cluttered and be more functional. I didn't love the box it came in, and some of the pieces were kind of difficult to get out, they were really stuck on each other. The directions were pretty good and easy to follow, assembly wasn't terrible either. Ultimately, I didn't end up keeping this, it oddly enough was a little too tall for the cabinet was planning on, I found an alternate spot, but honestly it just didn't hold the amount of items that I wanted it too. I ended up finding a different solution and returned this one.
